Cloud Computing Architecture and Scalability

Cloud computing provides on-demand availability of computer system resources such as data storage and computing power.
Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) offers fundamental computing infrastructure like virtual machines and raw block storage.
Platform as a Service (PaaS) delivers hardware and software tools over the internet for agile application development.
Software as a Service (SaaS) provides complete software applications accessible directly via modern web browsers.
Cloud elasticity allows organizations to scale computing capacity dynamically according to current real-time workload.
